route_title: Enhanced Perturbation with Outermost Layer Seeding
compilation_rationale: Fixed 24-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 stack compiled on fused silica. Initial thicknesses set to quarter-wave at 675 nm (~73.4 nm and ~115.8 nm). Broad positive bounds applied for gradient search. Unpolarized planar wave evaluated at 45° across 450–1000 nm. Four mean objectives enforce stopband reflectance maximization, stopband transmittance suppression, passband transmittance maximization, and passband reflectance suppression. Perturbation schedule logged for downstream hyperparameter routing. Registry-resolved materials used; extrapolation disabled.
